Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when the answer is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; absent on the first execution.

parentId.description: The parent category id; omitted for a root category.

path.description: The names from the root joined with "/".

400.description: idempotency-key-required (no Idempotency-Key header), idempotency-key-invalid (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters) or malformed-request (the body is empty, not valid JSON, has an unknown field, a field of the wrong type, trailing data, is larger than 64 KiB or contains a NUL character, U+0000, also as the escape \u0000; a NUL in the query string is the same 400). The Idempotency-Key checks run first and a request rejected here never records its key.

409.description: concurrent-update (another writer got in between the load and the save), a business conflict, or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body).

422.description: validation-failed, unknown-category (the parent is not in the tree), max-depth (ErrMaxDepth) or duplicate-sibling-name (ErrDuplicateSiblingName). Also validation-failed when the tree already holds its 5000 categories.

500.description: internal-error. The detail never leaks the cause ("an unexpected error occurred"); a 5xx is never stored under an Idempotency-Key.
